title: Beef and Pilaf Bowl
description: A hearty beef and pilaf bowl, inspired by Russian cuisine, with aromatic flavors.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp of aromatic oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer to a baking sheet.
Bake in the oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the beef reaches 63°C (145°F).
In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tbsp of aromatic oil.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 5 minutes, or until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the pilaf mix and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 250ml of hot water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in dried thyme.
Slice the cooked beef against the grain and serve with the pilaf.
